guidance.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its 10% to 12% order inflow guidance.
guidance.quote: And basis the conversion rate, it is fair for us to assume that we are on track to possibly do 10% to 12% order inflow guidance to meet.
guidance.speaker: Vinod Chari

guidance.claim: Capex details for the Lakshya plan will be finalized and announced in Q2.
guidance.quote: Hopefully in Q2, I think we will be able to finalize and let you know.
guidance.speaker: Sumit Kishore

guidance.claim: TenneT projects will be delivered over the next four to six months.
guidance.quote: we need to focus on delivery of those in the next four to six months, unless TenneT themselves expand the scope.
guidance.speaker: Subramanian Sarma

guidance.claim: Management does not expect any erosion in project margins.
guidance.quote: I don't expect that there will be any erosion in the margin.
guidance.speaker: Subramanian Sarma

guidance.claim: Large offshore megaprojects will be ready for dispatch from the Oman yard in Q1 of next calendar year.
guidance.quote: Yes, the large megaprojects in Offshore, they will be ready for dispatch from our Oman yard sometime in first quarter of next calendar year.
guidance.horizon: first quarter of next calendar year
guidance.speaker: Subramanian Sarma

reported.claim: The order book backlog has reached approximately Rs. 8 lakh crores.
reported.quote: 8 lakh crores in terms of the backlog.

reported.claim: Other income increased by 75% year-on-year to Rs. 23.7 billion.
reported.quote: 23.7 billion on a year- on-year basis.
reported.speaker: Sumit Kishore

reported.claim: The company delivered very good order inflow in Quarter 1.
reported.quote: We have delivered very good order inflow in the Quarter 1, better than what anybody had expected.
